rules: One document per condition: research/experiments/EX-ROS-2026-A022-results/metrics/<token>.json on the orchestration branch, written only after every condition has finished.
Every metric is an object {value, source, quality}. value is a number or null; null means unknown or unavailable and is never written as 0. quality is observed | derived | unavailable.
Raw inputs are preserved beside the document: get_session JSON per session, the session_metrics.py file per session, git outputs, CI run listings.
No metric is combined with another into a score. Token counts are not quality measures.
The orchestrator's own session is never counted in any condition; it is reported separately.

condition.launchOrder: integer, 1..4, from the orchestrator's random draw

sessions.description: one entry per implementing session (1 for grouped, 5 or more for independent), in start order

fields.guard: {expected, head, origin, branch, dirty, passed, repairs}
fields.usage: get_session.external_metadata.usage verbatim (input, output, cache-read, cache-write tokens, cost USD)

time.elapsed.span_seconds: first session createdAt to last session idleAt (independent includes the gaps between workers)
time.elapsed.session_sum_seconds: sum over sessions of idleAt - createdAt
time.elapsed.time_to_first_product_edit_secon: per session, from session_metrics.py (first code mutation)

activity (from session_metrics.py per se.model_requests: assistant messages with usage (distinct message ids)
activity (from session_metrics.py per se.file_reads: Read tool calls plus read commands
activity (from session_metrics.py per se.searches: Grep/Glob tool calls plus search commands
activity (from session_metrics.py per se.files_read_more_than_once.within_session: distinct paths read 2+ times in one session
activity (from session_metrics.py per se.files_read_more_than_once.across_conditi: distinct paths read in 2+ sessions of the condition; derived by the orchestrator from the sessions' event logs (list_events tool calls), null if the logs are not retrievable
activity (from session_metrics.py per se.governance_reads: reads of AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/00-governance/, docs/work-protocol.md, docs/cli.md, docs/planning.md and the other governance paths session_metrics.py lists
activity (from session_metrics.py per se.failed_builds_or_tests: build/test commands whose tool result reports failure; derived from event logs (session_metrics.py reports toolErrors only), null if unavailable
activity (from session_metrics.py per se.tool_errors: session_metrics.py toolErrors; retries of the same failed command derived from event logs where available, else null

repository (from git at the condition's.source_loc_added: git diff --numstat B final -- src/ (sum of added)
repository (from git at the condition's.source_loc_removed: git diff --numstat B final -- src/ (sum of removed)
repository (from git at the condition's.other_loc_added_removed: docs/, starter/, schemas/, tools/, registries/, root files, reported per top-level directory

ci (GitHub Actions 'Praxis validation' r.ci_runs_failed: count with conclusion other than success
ci (GitHub Actions 'Praxis validation' r.ci_final_conclusion: conclusion of the run for finalSha

protocol.guard_incidents: count of failed guards (repairs or replacements)
protocol.analysis_before_product_change: grouped only: boolean (first product-path commit is after the analysis commit)
protocol.cross_condition_access: list of any read/fetch of another condition's branch or the A022 design found in the event log (expected empty)
